contract.goal: Develop Iterfox's return-to-work experience so the operator can understand actual multi-mission progress without prompting repeatedly. Read docs/continuous-project-trial.md for the fixed scope and interfaces. The current outcome is the implementation target; future outcomes are handed to new missions automatically. Own ordinary reversible decisions. Report real blockers only. Keep original evidence, history, acceptance and permissions intact. This is an approved local implementation; no publication, deployment, push or merge. Existing UI and eleven Chrome workflows must remain functional. Do not edit protected tests or dependency files. Request host verification rather than running browser suites inside the agent sandbox. Technical completion remains subject to operator product review.

criteria.title: Cross-mission brief derives saved evidence and exports JSON/Markdown
All existing backend regression checks stay passing
Server and interface TypeScript remain valid
Production server and interface build successfully
Eleven existing Chrome workflows remain functional
Project brief and JSON/Markdown downloads work on desktop and mobile
Offline report is authenticated, escaped and tied to checkpoint evidence

milestones.title: An evidence-derived project brief
milestones.outcome: Implement Outcome 1 in docs/continuous-project-trial.md: read-only aggregate project brief with real checkpoint provenance, accurate shared usage, attention and authenticated JSON/Markdown exports. Build only this coherent backend result; later UI and HTML work belong to following missions.

milestones.title: A useful return-to-work view
milestones.outcome: Implement Outcome 2 in docs/continuous-project-trial.md using the preceding checkpointed backend. Add the selected-project morning brief, accurate attention/results, JSON and Markdown downloads with specified accessible labels, working 390px layout and existing control/recovery preservation. The offline HTML report is the next mission.

milestones.title: A portable project report
milestones.outcome: Implement Outcome 3 in docs/continuous-project-trial.md: readable script-free offline HTML report and authenticated attachment route, accessible report download in the existing brief, correct escaping/provenance and factual governance documentation. Preserve and reverify all earlier backend and interface behavior.
